authorization: Owner adopted the research-reset amendment of 2026-10-18 (docs/RESEARCH_RESET_AMENDMENT_20261018.md) authorizing this one registered development trial; the October 14, 2026 review otherwise stands. Scheduled training remains paused.
hypothesis: The existing day-sleeve feature contract carries positive out-of-sample edge after 10 bps round-trip costs when the label horizon matches the runtime hold contract (60 minutes, flat before the close) instead of the five-minute horizon that every prior trial and the scheduled trainer used.
economic_motivation: Runtime holds positions 600 to 7200 seconds and flattens 300 seconds before the close (AI_TRADING_MIN_POSITION_HOLD_SECONDS, AI_TRADING_MAX_POSITION_HOLD_SECONDS, AI_TRADING_EOD_FLATTEN_LEAD_SECONDS). Every model evaluated so far labeled a five-minute bar-open round trip net of a 10 to 12 bps cost: the always-long control lost 9.95 bps per opportunity by construction, the July 17 candidate's training labels had a mean realized edge of -11.93 bps with an 18.2 percent positive rate, and the scheduled trainer has reported no_qualified_candidate since. A five-minute gross move cannot clear a fixed 10 bps cost in large-cap names; a 60-minute horizon gives the same features a gross move of the order of the cost rather than one tenth of it. This is a horizon-contract question, not a new feature or family search.
model: StandardScaler plus HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=200, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=200, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False, random_state=42); fixed before evaluation; no family or parameter search
features: Existing day-sleeve feature contract (day_sleeve_ml_feature_contract_v1: rsi, macd, atr, vwap, sma_50, sma_200, signal, atr_pct, vwap_distance, sma_spread, macd_signal_gap, rsi_centered) computed from runtime-equivalent finalized regular-session five-minute history with a ten-calendar-day lookback
decision: Five-minute bar start plus five minutes and two seconds, identical to the retired replacement trial
entry: First one-minute open strictly after the finalized decision
exit: One-minute open 60 minutes after entry, same session only; opportunities whose exit would fall at or after 15:55 America/New_York are excluded, matching the runtime flatten lead
label: Net return from entry open to exit open minus the fixed 10 bps round-trip cost; positive class when net return exceeds zero
validation: Five chronological purged folds over the ordered development sessions (first chunk trains, each later chunk tests with expanding prior training), training-only scaling, purge of training labels whose exit falls after the fold boundary, one-session embargo, no overlapping positions per symbol
acceptance: Positive aggregate net edge per common opportunity at 10 bps including abstentions as zero; positive whole-session bootstrap 95 percent lower bound; at least four of five profitable folds; at least 250 selected trades per fold; improvement over always-long on identical opportunities; positive aggregate net edge at 20 bps reported but not required. Passing permits planning a governed retrain with AI_TRADING_DAY_SLEEVE_HORIZON_BARS=12 only; it is not promotion or runtime authority.

limitations: Bar-open markouts omit queue position, impact and distributions; they are not realized P&L.
Three symbols on 2024-2025 SIP data; passing does not generalize to the 100-symbol paper universe without a separately registered evaluation.
A fixed 60-minute exit is a proxy for the runtime stop, take-profit and trailing exits, not a replay of them.
